Data:Craft.keeper.strings.songs heart mu.Label: Craft: Swaddled Thunder
Data:Craft.keeper.strings.songs heart mu.StartDescription:
Sing storm-potential into the weft, to capture more Heart-aspect.

[Strings & Songs with Keeper-level <sprite name=heart>, plus Thunderskin's Paean, creates Swaddled Thunder.]
Data:Craft.keeper.strings.songs heart mu.Desc: Sleep, o thou tempest; for now, bow thy head….

Data:Craft.keeper.strings.songs sky maza.Label: Craft: Wind-in-Waiting
Data:Craft.keeper.strings.songs sky maza.StartDescription:
Secure a wind's promise from the Sky.

[Strings & Songs with Keeper-level <sprite name=sky>, plus Mazarine Fife, creates Wind-in-Waiting.]
Data:Craft.keeper.strings.songs sky maza.Desc: One last pipe-shrill, and the wind is still.

Data:Craft.keeper.surgeries.exsanguinati.Label: Craft: January Sanguinary
Data:Craft.keeper.surgeries.exsanguinati.StartDescription:
Enliven the soaks into something with a greater Heart-aspect.

[Surgeries & Exsanguinations with Keeper-level <sprite name=heart>, plus Gideon's Soaks, creates January Sanguinary.]

Data:Craft.keeper.surgeries.exsanguinati.Label: Craft: January Sanguinary
Data:Craft.keeper.surgeries.exsanguinati.StartDescription:
Enliven the toxin into something with a greater Heart-aspect.

[Surgeries & Exsanguinations with Keeper-level <sprite name=knock>, plus Glassfinger Toxin, creates January Sanguinary.]

Data:Craft.keeper.thegreatsignsandthegre.Label: Craft: Flushed Mommet
Data:Craft.keeper.thegreatsignsandthegre.StartDescription:
With Grail-essence, the mommet will redden into something more potent.

[The Great Signs and the Great Scars with Keeper-level <sprite name=grail>, plus Pale Mommet, creates Flushed Mommet.]
Data:Craft.keeper.thegreatsignsandthegre.Desc: Drink it in, little one. Drink it in….

Data:Craft.keeper.thegreatsignsandthegre.Label: Craft: Chronsichord
Data:Craft.keeper.thegreatsignsandthegre.StartDescription:
Place the gervinite at the heart of a Knock-device.

[The Great Signs and the Great Scars with Keeper-level <sprite name=knock>, plus Gervinite, creates Chronsichord.]
Data:Craft.keeper.thegreatsignsandthegre.Desc: When a chronsichord is completed, it is fully wound, for the first and only time.

Data:Craft.keeper.transformations.libera.Label: Craft: Orpiment Exultant
Data:Craft.keeper.transformations.libera.StartDescription: Transform the essence into the encaustum terminale Orpiment Exultant. [Transformations & Liberations with Keeper-level , plus Iotic Essence, creates Orpiment Exultant.]
Data:Craft.keeper.transformations.libera.Desc: [This is an encaustum terminale: one of the Great Inks. Use it with your journal to record a History and fulfil your reason for coming to Hush House… if you so choose.].

Data:Craft.keeper.transformations.libera.Label: Craft: Iotic Essence
Data:Craft.keeper.transformations.libera.StartDescription:
Transform this into a ruddy essence of Forge-power.

[Transformations & Liberations with Keeper-level <sprite name=forge>, plus Xanthotic Essence, creates Iotic Essence.]

Data:Craft.keeper.transformations.libera.Label: Craft: Iotic Essence
Data:Craft.keeper.transformations.libera.StartDescription:
Transform these salts into a ruddy essence of Forge-power.

[Transformations & Liberations with Keeper-level <sprite name=forge>, plus Bitterblack Salts, creates Iotic Essence.]

Data:Craft.keeper.transformations.libera.Label: Craft: Skinshuck Mead
Data:Craft.keeper.transformations.libera.StartDescription:
Brew a Moth-liquor with the honey.

[Transformations & Liberations with Keeper-level <sprite name=moth>, plus Cuckoo-Honey, creates Skinshuck Mead.]
Data:Craft.keeper.transformations.libera.Desc: ''One taste to sleep, two to wake, for what are eyelids but the skin of the eyes?'.

Data:Craft.keeper.transformations.libera.Label: Craft: Perilous Imago
Data:Craft.keeper.transformations.libera.StartDescription:
Coax the larva to develop into a greater Moth-beast.

[Transformations & Liberations with Keeper-level <sprite name=moth>, plus Chimeric Larva, creates Perilous Imago.]
Data:Craft.keeper.transformations.libera.Desc: One wet wing, then the other, and then it shakes them dry; and from that point, it will bear watching always.

Data:Craft.keeper.tridesmahiera grail ru.Label: Craft: Sacrament Calicite
Data:Craft.keeper.tridesmahiera grail ru.StartDescription:
Use this liquor as a base for a Grail-sacrament.

[Tridesma Hiera with Keeper-level <sprite name=grail>, plus Rubywise Ruin, creates Sacrament Calicite.]
Data:Craft.keeper.tridesmahiera grail ru.Desc: In the name of the Hour that gives life; of the Hour that takes life; of the Hour that is not sated….

Data:Craft.keeper.tridesmahiera moon asi.Label: Craft: Black Sapphire Wash
Data:Craft.keeper.tridesmahiera moon asi.StartDescription:
Darken the asimel into a potent Moon-pigment.

[Tridesma Hiera with Keeper-level <sprite name=moon>, plus Asimel, creates Black Sapphire Wash.]
Data:Craft.keeper.tridesmahiera moon asi.Desc: Whence came the light in the House of the Moon? We still don't know; but perhaps this colour is its darkness.

Data:Craft.keeper.tridesmahiera nectar l.Label: Craft: Marakat
Data:Craft.keeper.tridesmahiera nectar l.StartDescription: Brew the encaustum terminale called Marakat. [Tridesma Hiera with Keeper-level , plus Leathy, creates Marakat.]
Data:Craft.keeper.tridesmahiera nectar l.Desc: [This is an encaustum terminale: one of the Great Inks. Use it with your journal to record a History and fulfil your reason for coming to Hush House… if you so choose.].

Data:Craft.keeper.watchmansparadoxes lan.Label: Craft: Uzult
Data:Craft.keeper.watchmansparadoxes lan.StartDescription: Brighten the essence into the encaustum terminale Uzult. [Watchman's Paradoxes with Keeper-level , plus Xanthotic Essence, creates Uzult.]
Data:Craft.keeper.watchmansparadoxes lan.Desc: [This is an encaustum terminale: one of the Great Inks. Use it with your journal to record a History and fulfil your reason for coming to Hush House… if you so choose.].

Data:Craft.keeper.watchmansparadoxes lan.Label: Craft: Ashartine
Data:Craft.keeper.watchmansparadoxes lan.StartDescription:
Brew the bright ink ashartine from the ichor.

[Watchman's Paradoxes with Keeper-level <sprite name=lantern>, plus Ichor Vitreous, creates Ashartine.]
Data:Craft.keeper.watchmansparadoxes lan.Desc: While the vapours of ashartine's making hang in the air, it is very difficult to speak a lie aloud….

Data:Craft.keeper.weaving.knotworking he.Label: Craft: Swaddled Thunder
Data:Craft.keeper.weaving.knotworking he.StartDescription:
Draw storm-potential into the weft, to capture more Heart-aspect.

[Weaving & Knotworking with Keeper-level <sprite name=heart>, plus Frith-Weft, creates Swaddled Thunder.]
Data:Craft.keeper.weaving.knotworking he.Desc: Sleep, o thou tempest; for now, bow thy head….

Data:Craft.keeper.weaving.knotworking wi.Label: Craft: Wyrd-Weft
Data:Craft.keeper.weaving.knotworking wi.StartDescription:
Draw Winter into a web of little fates.

[Weaving & Knotworking with Keeper-level <sprite name=winter>, plus fabric, creates Wyrd-Weft.]
Data:Craft.keeper.weaving.knotworking wi.Desc: Every thread a future, and every other thread a past.

Data:Craft.keeper.wolfstories moon stymp.Label: Craft: Wormwood Dream
Data:Craft.keeper.wolfstories moon stymp.StartDescription:
Interpret the stymphling's hisses into a crime-prophecy of Moon and Winter.

[Wolf Stories with Keeper-level <sprite name=moon>, plus Stymphling, creates Wormwood Dream.]
Data:Craft.keeper.wolfstories moon stymp.Desc: Let's hope it's equally possible to forget this again.

Data:Craft.keeper.wolfstories scale old..Label: Craft: Earthquake Name
Data:Craft.keeper.wolfstories scale old..StartDescription:
Discern a potency of Scale.

[Wolf Stories with Keeper-level <sprite name=scale>, plus Old Moment, creates Earthquake Name.]
Data:Craft.keeper.wolfstories scale old..Desc: Speak half a syllable, and feel the beast stir half a coil....

Data:Craft.leaves.thorns witching.tisane.Label: Craft: Witching Tisane
Data:Craft.leaves.thorns witching.tisane.StartDescription:
The odd leaf and the occasional berry, dried to brew a tisane. 

[Leaves & Thorns with Prentice-level <sprite name=grail> creates Witching Tisane. Or for a Scholar-level recipe: if I add a Flower, the mixture will become intoxicating.]
Data:Craft.leaves.thorns witching.tisane.Desc: It's best when it's warm; but it'll keep.

Data:Craft.lockworks.clockworks ampoule..Label: Craft: Amethyst Ampoule
Data:Craft.lockworks.clockworks ampoule..StartDescription:
Blend acids for a paradoxical Knock-ampoule. 

[Lockworks & Clockworks with Prentice-level <sprite name=knock> creates Amethyst Ampoule. Or for a Scholar-level recipe: if I add Glass, I'll create a Knock-alloy of interest to the most ambitious clockmakers.]
Data:Craft.lockworks.clockworks ampoule..Desc: It has its uses, but none of them are simple and few are safe.

Data:Craft.lockworks.clockworks awakened.StartDescription:
Enact a life-current in an abandoned feather. 

[Lockworks & Clockworks with Prentice-level <sprite name=sky> creates Awakened Feather. Or for a Scholar-level recipe: enact those life-currents in Metal, and create an exotic alloy.]
Data:Craft.lockworks.clockworks awakened.Desc: A smooth sweep of quill alert with life.

Data:Craft.maggephenemysteries eigengrau.Label: Craft: Eigengrau
Data:Craft.maggephenemysteries eigengrau.StartDescription:
Distil a kind of possibility. 

[Maggephene Mysteries with Prentice-level <sprite name=moon> creates Eigengrau. Or for a Scholar-level recipe: crush a Flower in, and mix a pale and chilling draught.]
Data:Craft.maggephenemysteries eigengrau.Desc: The surface of the substance is difficult to resolve - almost as if it weren't there at all.

Data:Craft.maggephenemysteries liquid.re.Label: Craft: Regensburg Balm
Data:Craft.maggephenemysteries liquid.re.StartDescription:
Mix something to keep disease at bay. 

[Maggephene Mysteries with Prentice-level <sprite name=heart> creates Regensburg Balm. Or for a Scholar-level recipe: if I add a suitably aspected Liquid, I'll brew something more potent.]
Data:Craft.maggephenemysteries liquid.re.Desc: Medicine should smell like this: reassuringly offputting.

Data:Craft.meniscatereflections material.Label: Craft: Westcott's Compounds
Data:Craft.meniscatereflections material.StartDescription:
The Reflections include alchemical techniques. I can use those to prepare an odd set of compounds with a variety of uses. 

[Meniscate Reflections with Prentice-level <sprite name=forge> creates Westcott's Compounds. Or if I add Liquid to Scholar-level Forge, the essences will take longer to cool, and redden into something more potent.]
Data:Craft.meniscatereflections material.Desc: Westcott probably didn't invent all these, but he knew how to make a name stick.

Data:Craft.meniscatereflections material.Label: Craft: Westcott's Compounds
Data:Craft.meniscatereflections material.StartDescription: The Reflections include alchemical techniques. I can use those to prepare an odd set of compounds with a variety of uses. (Or for a Scholar-level recipe:  if I add Liquid, but retain this much Forge, the essences will take longer to cool, and redden into something more potent.)
Data:Craft.meniscatereflections material.Desc: Westcott probably didn't invent all these, but he knew how to make a name stick.

Data:Craft.meniscatereflections torgues..Label: Craft: Torgue's Cleansing
Data:Craft.meniscatereflections torgues..StartDescription:
Purge myself of harmonious resonances, accruing some personal Edge. It won't be pleasant. 

[Meniscate Reflections with Prentice-level <sprite name=edge> creates Torgue's Cleansing. Or for a Scholar-level recipe: add something with a Memory aspect, and I have the makings of a significant Edge Memory.]
Data:Craft.meniscatereflections torgues..Desc: The Cleansing has left my skin burning, my teeth throbbing. The Corrivality rumbles beneath the membraneous surfaces of the waking world.
